name: Gaekwar Mills Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1928, Gaekwar Mills Ltd
is in the business of manufacturing Fabrics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TGML was in Textile Manufacturing. However, it is not carrying on any business activities due to labour unrest. The company went into BIFR as its unit was declared sick and was under the revival scheme approved by the BIFR Board.
 As per the sanctioned scheme, company has to set up a same textile product with similar modern textile machinery on 40% of the company’s land at Bilimora, and remaining 60% land can be utilized for the Real Estate Development and the funds generated from real estate operation will be utilized to redeem Debentures, set up New Textile units and meet working capital Requirements. 
The company is in process of taking necessary approvals from the Municipal Corporation and other Government departments and it is hopeful that the construction activities can be started in due course of time

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
